mapper.select: SELECT wd.dept_id AS dept_id, d.name AS dept_name, wd.default_role AS default_role, au.name AS assigned_by_name, wd.created_at AS assigned_at FROM platform_workspace_dept wd LEFT JOIN system_dept d ON d.id = wd.dept_id LEFT JOIN system_user au ON au.id = wd.created_by AND au.is_deleted = 0 WHERE wd.workspace_code = #{workspaceCode} AND wd.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY wd.created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT wd.dept_id FROM platform_workspace_dept wd JOIN system_dept root ON root.id = wd.dept_id AND root.is_deleted = 0 JOIN system_dept sub ON (sub.id = root.id OR sub.path LIKE CONCAT(root.path, root.id, '/%')) AND sub.is_deleted = 0 JOIN system_user_dept ud ON ud.dept_id = sub.id AND ud.user_id = #{userId} AND ud.is_deleted = 0 WHERE wd.workspace_code = #{workspaceCode} AND wd.is_deleted = 0
AND wd.dept_id != #{excludeDeptId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO platform_workspace_dept (workspace_code, dept_id, default_role, is_deleted, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.workspaceCode}, #{item.deptId}, #{item.defaultRole}, 0, #{item.createdBy}, #{item.updatedBy}, NOW(), NOW())
